externalTools.name: FFmpeg
externalTools.note: External process, not in the npm packages. Bundled (GPL-2.0-or-later build) in the render-cpu, render-gpu, blender and worker images. The render manifest records the exact build license and codec licenses.

externalTools.name: Chromium (via Playwright)
externalTools.note: Downloaded by Playwright, not in the npm packages. Bundled in the render-cpu, render-gpu, blender and worker images.

externalTools.name: Blender
externalTools.note: Optional external process for blender nodes, not in the npm packages and never linked. Bundled only in the openvideo-blender image (GPL-3.0-or-later binary, source offer in the image inventory).

externalTools.name: Piper, espeak-ng, whisper.cpp
externalTools.note: Optional external speech engines; not bundled in the npm packages or images.
